items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1962-01-03
items.q: Him and Bunker together was tough.

ctx.x: Well would he just play a lot of chords and runs or would he make up his own melodies?

He'd put it in. Yeah he'd put his own melody in just like any trumpet was. He'd put it in and take it after him, look around and laugh at you, how you like him. Bunker was a trumpet player. Well, both of them was good. Him and Bunker together was tough.
Well who had the growling style of clarinet then, you know, with a ratty tone and rough? Ratty and rough. Ratty and rough. Who was rough then in the clarinet players?
